main.description: Returns the representative entity-follow record for one actor and entity URI, or explicit null when the relationship is not indexed. Duplicate relationships use the record with earliest createdAt, URI ascending as tie-breaker. Operational failures return errors, never a missing-relationship response. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID of the actor who published the entity-follow record.

entity.description: Full DID-authority AT-URI of the followed record identity; matching does not pin a CID or restrict the target collection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, entity AT-URI, or query parameters are invalid.

follow.description: Raw representative entity-follow record, or null when no matching relationship is indexed.
